build_heads_dict_from_dict_conf: build a HeadsDict from a dictionary of head configurations with task names and loss mappings
build_heads_dict_from_list_conf: build a HeadsDict from a list of head configurations without explicit task names
test_heads_dict_forward: test the HeadsDict forward pass with a task name, model output tensor, and sample list
test_heads_dict_multiple_losses: test the HeadsDict forward pass with multiple loss types configured per task
test_heads_dict_multiple_tasks: test the HeadsDict forward pass selecting a specific task from multiple configured tasks
